messages:
Tara - People Ops: FYI cohort arrives Fri 8:30am in SF. Things to cover: I-9 kiosk booking, BG intake, benefits overview at 11, payroll/DD setup assistance, and one hire (Sam) whose passport renewal delayed. Can we plan a safe Day-1 arrival with I-9 contingency? @LegalBot @Omar @Felix
Omar - Facilities: I can reserve lobby kiosk for 8:30-10:30 and 6 parking passes. Need full names for passes by EOD Thu. Shuttle can run at 8:00.
Felix - IT: Laptops pre-staged; imaging slot 8:40 or 9:20. Will tag devices with "onboard-friday". If Sam can't present passport, we can still issue a temporary badge after compliance sign-off, but no prod access.
Tara - People Ops: Sam says passport ETA day 5. Hiring manager wants Sam to start Day 1 remotely if necessary. Is that allowed?
LegalBot: Reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days. If passport delayed, acceptable alternatives require combination of List B + C documents. SSA receipts alone not sufficient. Remote notarization is an exception but requires pre-approval from compliance. Please submit Sam's doc timeline to compliance@redwood.com with expected dates.
BGVendor: BG status for cohort: 4 cleared, 1 in-progress (name match flagged), Sam flagged as "pending-docs" due to passport. Expected resolution: 48-72h after docs uploaded.
Sam - New Hire: I uploaded my SSA receipt and driver's license to the portal; passport renewal tracking number shows delivery in 5 days. Hoping to start in person but can do remote if needed.
Maya - People Ops: For payroll/direct deposit: new hires should fill the payroll form before Day 1. We include link in the calendar invite; remind folks to bring voided check or bank details. We'll have a payroll station at 2pm for Qs.
Tara - People Ops: Logistics checklist: parking passes sent by 5pm, kiosk reserved 8:30-10:30, catering continental (GF and vegan labels), benefits 11:00-11:25 overview, payroll station 2pm. I've pinged hiring manager to accept limited non-prod access if Sam needs it.
Omar - Facilities: Conf F is wheelchair accessible. Catering will label items and note nut-free options.
Felix - IT: Imaging command for on-site run: `redwood-provision --cohort may-friday --profile standard`. If someone needs dongles/adapters, reply here now.
Sam - New Hire: I need an HDMI adapter if in office.
Felix - IT: Noted, will bring one.
LegalBot: Compliance: please file exception request for Sam if remote notarization is needed. Email compliance@redwood.com with the hire's case number and expected doc delivery.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: may-friday-onboard-3955555555 (#50121). Due: 2026-09-01.
Tara - People Ops: Thanks team  I'll follow up once compliance responds and post the final roster. Anyone else to loop in?
